task: Learn a fixed-length structured two-option decision policy derived from the canonical constitution.

official_hrm.cluster_stage: official implementation pinned to the same commit

arms.train_target: hard prohibition ordering, then priority-weighted tenets
unweighted sum of visible tenet scores
deterministic permutation of constitutional training labels

gates.pass: official repository and immutable commit are recorded
HRM-format arrays validate, constitution hash matches, splits are group-disjoint, and labels are balanced
trainer inherits hard RAM and CPU job limits before its first instruction, with PID-scoped I/O abort telemetry and cleanup
all arms instantiate, evaluate at baseline, and emit parseable receipts without optimizer steps
constitutional ID and contrast accuracy are at least 0.75 and contrast exceeds shuffled by at least 0.10
the signal repeats on three preregistered seeds with no split or hyperparameter changes
the official pinned HRM code consumes the same dataset contract and clears a two-hour 8xA100 stop rule

stop_rules: Stop local training on timeout, cap violation, non-finite loss, malformed receipt, or missing checkpoint.
Do not promote when constitutional contrast accuracy is below 0.75 or its delta over shuffled is below 0.10.
Do not start the official cluster lane before three-seed local confirmation.
